title: Bluetooth Keyboard & Mouse
meta_description: Turn your Android device into a serverless Bluetooth Remote Keyboard & Mouse!
full_description: Use your Android device as a remote keyboard and mouse for your Smartphone, Tablet, Computer or Android TV.- Low latency Bluetooth connection without additional software- Turn your smartphone into a touchpad with scrolling support- Use any keyboard app to type text on the remote device with support for 33 different keyboard language layouts- Multimedia mode for controlling media players with controls for playback, volume and navigation *- Numpad and presenter control modes *- Create your own custom layouts for specific controls for an application or game *- Turn your phone into an movement based Air mouse *- Use speech input and send copied text to connected devices ** Premium featureThe receiving device must have Bluetooth. The following operating systems have been successfully tested:Android and Android TVApple iOS and iPad OSWindows 8.1 and higherChromebook Chrome OSIf you have issues or feature requests please visit the support forum on GitHub:https://github.com/AppGround-io/bluetooth-keyboard-and-mouse-support/discussions
